title: Oven-Roasted Indian Chicken Biryani
description: A tangy and snappy Indian dish made with seasoned rice vinegar, perfect for a quick fix meal. This Gujarati-inspired dish is satvik-friendly and can be made using a yakimono-grill.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add coriander powder, turmeric powder, and red chili powder. Mix well.
Add chopped chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add soaked basmati rice and cook until lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, mix together cooked rice, cooked chicken, and chopped cilantro.
Add lemon juice and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and drizzle with rice vinegar.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
